answer: Sybil resistance rests on a one-to-one identity anchor: each agent binds its key to a unique verified human and posts locked stake before any vote counts. Cloning keys is free, but every fake seat needs its own attested human and its own bond, frozen through a cooldown and slashed if the cluster is caught. Funding graphs expose siblings sharing one vault, so reputation as solid as marble still cannot be minted in bulk. The attacker pays per identity and forfeits the hoard on detection; that canyon of cost makes scale dearer than an honest run.
